verdict.rationale: Apple M5 is a system-on-chip, so a built-in task-delegating AI assistant is not a capability this kind of product ships; that is a category error. The evidence only says M5 accelerates software AI (Apple Intelligence, Image Playground, third-party apps), which belongs to the host platform and apps, not the chip, so the exception for a shipped wrong-axis capability does not apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
